items.title: Mike Longo interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2019
items.q: I’ve played with Elvin, I’ve played with all those drummers man

ctx.x: And I teach people how to play the African drumming and then how to put it on the instrument. And so when you learn this drumming thing, this is an oversimplification, but jazz is basically African drumming on a piano. And so you hear guys talking about, “Well they’re just subdividing” or they’re talking about practicing with a metronome. So I told this guy, I was having this big argument on the internet with this Ph.D. from North Carolina. And he took issue with me telling people don’t practice with a metronome.…
